title: lepidaploa orbicularis
intro: Lepidaploa orbicularis, commonly known as the "Buttercup Tree," is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Lepidaploa orbicularis include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
